feature: C/D vision tasks recalibrate position (measured return to the arrival point) and heading (vision-derived bias)
scope: Host only. Firmware untouched (board already reports 0.2.29 with nav_reference=1).

deploy.hash_verification: all seven files match local SHA-256

behaviour.position: NAV POSE is sent before any vision motion; the board integrates every commanded pulse; the task ends with measured return to the arrival XY in <=20 pulses (max 8 moves) and NAV RESTORE at the station coordinate
behaviour.right_steps: no longer defines the exit (field kept for config compatibility, exit == arrival point)
behaviour.heading: delta = heading_cd - configured arrival heading; |delta| > 6 deg faults; otherwise delta is added to every later NAV EXEC angle
behaviour.frame: board map origin and yaw origin unchanged; station attitudes unchanged; with no bias the wire angle equals the configured angle (180 stays 180)
behaviour.bias_reset: NAV RESET (rebuild origin) clears the bias

remote_tests.command: python3 -m unittest tests.test_ring_task tests.test_material_flow tests.test_mission tests.test_competition tests.test_webapp -q

local_suite.known: ARM-emulation tests expect an imu_stale fault where 0.2.28+ pauses instead

not_verified: No real C/D run: the extra return move (~1800/2150 pulses) and the vision heading bias have not been observed on the vehicle
Bias magnitude tolerance of 6 deg is a design choice, not yet measured in the field
